findings.issue: The decomposition is of the time derivative of relative entropy, not relative entropy itself. The narrative section already states this correctly.
findings.correction: A decomposition of the time derivative of relative entropy separates a dominant negative term proportional to N times expected KSD squared from a smaller positive term, starting from a regular initial distribution.

findings.issue: The abstract explicitly explains near optimal as matching corresponding i.i.d. rates; the unknowns incorrectly say its meaning is unspecified.
findings.correction: The abstract does not specify the exact assumptions, constants, time horizons, or precise meaning of the double-exponential improvement; it defines near optimal by comparison with corresponding i.i.d. rates.

findings.issue: The abstract does specify late-stage concentration and a final-step global merge, so an unqualified statement that synchronization schedules are unspecified is inaccurate.
findings.correction: The abstract does not specify datasets, empirical comparator identities, numerical communication budgets, full synchronization schedules, or quantitative performance gains.

findings.issue: Presenting 7.6% to 42.9% as the frontier-CUA ASR range makes 42.9% an unsupported upper bound. S6 reports two named models and identifies only the lower endpoint as most secure; it does not identify the maximum ASR across evaluated CUAs.
findings.correction: The authors report ASRs of 7.6% for Operator and 42.9% for Claude 3.7 Sonnet | CUA, attempts up to 92.5%, and end-to-end ASRs up to 50%.

findings.issue: Two evaluated CUAs are named; the missing information is the complete evaluated set, not all information about the CUA sample.
findings.correction: The abstract does not specify the complete evaluated CUA set, detailed benchmark construction or splits, statistical uncertainty, or defense baselines.

summary.scope: Read all eight supplied abstracts and corresponding extraction fields. Findings concern source fidelity only; no cards were edited and no gate was issued. This AI review does not establish experimental validity, lesson effectiveness, or Oral selection causes.
